description: Distributed locks for Node.js on Redis and Valkey: single-server locks, Redlock across independent servers, atomic multi-key locks on one server, automatic extension with an AbortSignal. Works with node-redis, ioredis and Valkey GLIDE.
rules: Wrap the Redis client in NodeRedisAdapter, IoredisAdapter or GlideAdapter and pass it as adapter (createLock) or adapters (createRedlock).
createLock and createRedlock return one lock object per key; call acquire(), using(), extend(handle, ttl) and release(handle) on it.
The API differs from the redlock package: there is no new Redlock(clients) and no acquire([resources], ttl).
Prefer lock.using(async (signal) => { ... }); the cause of a lost lock is in signal.error.
release() and extend() resolve false when the lock is gone; they reject on Redis errors and invalid arguments.
LockManager acquireBatch and usingBatch lock several keys atomically on one server; on Redis Cluster all keys must share a hash slot.
createRedlock takes adapters; LockManager takes nodes.
The library issues no fencing tokens; if correctness depends on the lock, also make the write conditional in the data store.
